methodological_limits: Compiling this index from source records earns no additional primary-reading credit. All coverage remains attributed to the original receipt sets identified by hashes.
Identity and interval checks establish reproducibility of selected received material, not independent proof of comprehension, historical authenticity or philosophical truth.
A complete received electronic body need not preserve the complete historical composition or every word of a modern critical edition.
No complete second traversal is claimed for the new ordered studies. Rereads overlap first-pass coverage and are never added as newly read body units.

Page, paragraph and newline coordinates are different units and are not aggregated into one page total. Whitespace words are transcription token counts, not counts of distinct ideas or textual witnesses.

Source authors, reported opponents, dialectical concessions, transmitted reports, translators and modern editors are distinct voices. Historical science, polemic and legal claims are not newly endorsed findings or present advice.

works.philosophical_scope: The common-Creator and source/perfection arguments have genuine affirmative and exclusionary intent. Their connection, identity, predicate-eligibility and causal-role premises remain separate reconstruction obligations; unrestricted source mode is not a simple restatement of the work.

major_argument_return_points.title: Prophetic signs real powers and reductive explanations
major_argument_return_points.voice: Authorial concessions to psychic and natural efficacy followed by criticism of their proposed exhaustiveness.
major_argument_return_points.point: Affirming fire, water and unusual capacities does not identify the actual source, scope and purpose of every prophetic event.

major_argument_return_points.title: An active Creator and determinate products
major_argument_return_points.voice: Authorial reasoning and conditional dilemmas; rival eternal-cause account separately quoted.
major_argument_return_points.point: Activity in type differs from eternity of this product; finite sources can await external conditions, while complete original provision adds its own scope claim.

major_argument_return_points.title: A concrete necessary bearer and intrinsic attributes
major_argument_return_points.voice: Authorial distinctions between mental generality, intrinsic qualification and external efficient production.
major_argument_return_points.point: Establishing a necessary existent does not automatically identify the Maker; requiring one’s own attributes is not receiving an outside maker.

major_argument_return_points.title: Positive perfection and creature relative predicates
major_argument_return_points.voice: Authorial comparison with explicit eligibility restrictions; newer print restores an electronic omission.
major_argument_return_points.point: Giving perfection is a substantive comparative argument, not a rule transferring every produced property to its producer; humility and need can perfect creatures while not qualifying the independent source.

major_argument_return_points.title: Common original agency and distinct causal relations
major_argument_return_points.voice: Authorial unity and inseparability arguments, with quoted celestial-final-cause account distinguished.
major_argument_return_points.point: Interdependence and a unitary generated object are meant to exclude plural ultimate makers; connection and individuation premises require defence. A desired end is not thereby an efficient origin.

major_argument_return_points.title: Epistemic routes textual controls and received closure
major_argument_return_points.locator: S002L0206–0208; S003L0414–0419; S004L0052–0063; correction catalogue atPDF41–47
major_argument_return_points.voice: Authorial plural routes, received colophon and modern editorial interventions kept distinct.
major_argument_return_points.point: Direct recognition, reasoning and testimony need not follow one universal sequence; all94 catalogue items are mapped without claiming every edited body page was read.

orthogonal_topic_return_points.title: Speech content recitation and voluntary acts
orthogonal_topic_return_points.voice: Substantial authorial theological discussion; speech, reciter’s voice and creating another’s speech are distinguished.
orthogonal_topic_return_points.research_status: Broader source matter retained; historical and legal assertions not independently endorsed.

orthogonal_topic_return_points.title: Creation materials temporal language and cosmic transformation
orthogonal_topic_return_points.voice: Reports about throne, water, pen, decree and resurrection retain variants and scriptural assumptions; occurrence and possibility are distinct.
orthogonal_topic_return_points.research_status: Broader source matter retained; historical and legal assertions not independently endorsed.

orthogonal_topic_return_points.title: Inspired experience intercession and limits on blame
orthogonal_topic_return_points.voice: Genuine psychic phenomena are conceded; inward directness is not sufficient reliability; historical punitive claims and allowances for excused error remain attributed.
orthogonal_topic_return_points.research_status: Broader source matter retained; historical and legal assertions not independently endorsed.

orthogonal_topic_return_points.title: Human fulfilment universals and the use of sciences
orthogonal_topic_return_points.voice: Knowledge, love, will and delight differ; abstract cognition and sound mathematics/natural knowledge can have genuine value.
orthogonal_topic_return_points.research_status: Broader source matter retained; historical and legal assertions not independently endorsed.

orthogonal_topic_return_points.title: Differing laws treaties and justice to opponents
orthogonal_topic_return_points.voice: Neutral scientific agreement, common religion, legal differences and unconditional justice are preserved beside severe polemic; no current legal recommendation.
